title: Children in the Attic
description: A group of six children sit together in a dark, circular attic space surrounded by pipes and wooden beams. They are illuminated by floating, glowing orbs and crescent shapes that drift through the black air above them.
prompt: A group of young children sitting closely together inside a dark circular attic filled with wooden beams and curving metal pipes. They look up in amazement at dozens of glowing white crescent moons and luminous orbs floating in the black space above them. Dramatic low lighting, painterly brushwork, moody and mysterious atmosphere, dark fantasy style.
